source.dual_mono: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no interchannel cancellation, other-channel-exclusive content omitted

policies.partial: Retain at most 2.5 dB measured natural growth
policies.natural_limited: Retain natural growth until 4.5 dB cap; cap applied smoothly as linked control gain, no limiter

perceptual_status: Timbre, localization, externalization, closeness and comfort PENDING HUMAN
input_loop: Same 2s own-stem probe, 20ms boundary fades, twelve repeats in a 24s diagnostic montage
limitation: Static RMS calibration controls gain, not perceptual loudness. Nominal .25m display rounds to tenths.
distance_cue_analysis: Static level-matched waveform residual and band deltas quantify changes remaining after best linked scalar fit. Small residuals indicate gain-dominated control, not verified physical near-field cues.
